parent_direction: IRC from Main after reading checkpoint-001: (1) no fresh/unbounded I/O allowance for a HELD commit after deadline_check raises or a BaseException; (2) a written RELEASED registry line can survive later fsync/close/deadline failure, so effective release binds to successful ACK plus the caller-observed successful outcome, and any needed final receipt/interface is identified, not faked; (3) spec.identities cannot prove complete historical ownership; the identity union is an explicit raw-adapter/parent-authenticated prerequisite; no new launch authority, clocks or signals.

delta.D1_deadline_crossing: Replaces checkpoint-001 'bounded HELD commit still attempted after a crossing'. The first crossing (deadline_check raised Exception or returned non-None) stops ALL further callbacks and module I/O: no owned_date call, no disposition create/write/fsync, no readback, no registry append. Result is an in-memory HELD with disposition null and an explicit uncertainty statement. Crossing after the disposition write: disposition exists unacknowledged, no readback, no registry line. Crossing after the ACK readback: no registry append (P5_DEADLINE_AFTER_ACK). Crossing after the registry append (final check): the written line survives, result HELD (P5_DEADLINE_AFTER_ACK).
delta.D2_base_exception: Replaces checkpoint-001 'ticks disabled during the HELD attempt'. After a non-Exception BaseException during evaluation or owned_date, the HELD commit is attempted ONLY if deadline_check, read_bytes and owned_date have not raised a BaseException in this call and the original deadline has not been crossed; it runs under the ORIGINAL deadline with the same checks after every blocking step and stops at the first crossing. Otherwise the BaseException is re-raised immediately with no further I/O. Any BaseException inside the commit phase propagates immediately (original attached as __context__ when unset).
delta.D3_effective_release: result.state == RELEASED requires: decision RELEASED, ACK_OK, RELEASED registry line completely written, fsync returned, registry and directory descriptors closed without failure, and a final deadline check after the append passed. Registry close failure now fires P5_REGISTRY_APPEND_FAILED. The registry line carries an explicit statement that its syntax alone is not completed authority. Downstream authority = registry RELEASED line AND caller-observed result.state RELEASED.
delta.D4_no_new_clock: time.monotonic bracketing of census.observed_at_mono is removed (no new clocks). Census freshness rests on this module invoking census() after parts 1-3 inside the call; the callback must not cache (caller precondition). P4_CENSUS_STALE is retained with narrowed meaning: observed_at_mono is not a finite float.
delta.D5_identity_union: Part 4 proves endedness only for the supplied identity union plus current-census group and parent-link checks. Completeness of that union (omitted historical incarnations, reparented or escaped unproved processes) is an external raw-adapter/parent-authenticated prerequisite; the disposition records identity_union_completeness = EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITE_NOT_VERIFIED and never claims it.

contract_proposals_not_implemented.CP1_caller_release_receipt: Proposed parent-owned interface parent-release-caller-receipt-v1: after decide_and_commit RETURNS state RELEASED, the caller exclusively writes a receipt {item, disposition {path, sha256}, registry_line_sha256, result_sha256 (canonical returned dict), caller owned /bin/date text} with fsync and readback. Capacity accounting would treat a reservation as released only when the RELEASED registry line AND this receipt exist. Not implemented by this worker; requires a separate parent contract.
contract_proposals_not_implemented.CP2_identity_union_record: Proposed pinned spec field identities_union {path, sha256}: a raw-adapter-produced, parent-authenticated union of every applicable incarnation (driver, main child, helpers, descendants, unproved/unknown, oracle) whose rows must equal spec.identities. Not implemented: the frozen contract has no such field; completeness stays an explicit external prerequisite.
contract_proposals_not_implemented.CP3_post_crossing_record: If the parent wants on-disk HELD evidence after a crossing, it must be a NEW separately admitted transaction with its own fresh deadline; this module will not extend I/O past the original deadline.
